blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For using her cellphone while driving, Pop girl group BINI member Mikha Lim has apologized, calling her actions “careless and irresponsible” and vowing to be more mindful on the road. Addressing the incident captured in a viral video, Lim posted the apology on her social media account on Wednesday evening. “There is absolutely no excuse for using my phone while behind the wheel,” she said. “I take full accountability for what happened.” READ: LTO warns vs distracted driving anew amid BINI’s Mikha Lim viral video She added that she had already reported to the LTO and was undergoing […]...
